activeDevices.signOutFromAllDevices: Sign out from all other devices

organizationSettings.heading: Organization Settings
organizationSettings.subheading: Manage your organization's working hours and time zone
organizationSettings.sameForAllDays: Use the same time for all days
organizationSettings.timeZoneSubheading: Times across the organization are shown in this zone.
organizationSettings.workingHoursSubheading: The days and hours your team is on duty.

escalationSettings.heading: Escalation & SLA
escalationSettings.subheading: Each template runs for every new flag of its colour. If a step's deadline passes with no response, the alert escalates to the next step. Drag a step by its handle to reorder.
escalationSettings.stepsSubheading: The timer starts when the caregiver's submission lands. Each deadline is how long that person has to respond. Region nurses are filled in automatically when a patient has no assigned nurse.

primaryNurse.label: Region primary nurse
primaryNurse.hint: Auto — used when the patient has no primary nurse or they don't respond

secondaryNurse.label: Region secondary nurse
secondaryNurse.hint: Auto — used when the patient has no secondary nurse or they don't respond

escalationSettings.finalStep: Final step — the alert stays open with the admin until it is resolved
escalationSettings.adminPinned: Admin is always the final step
escalationSettings.reorderAriaLabel: Reorder step {{step}}. Drag, or use the arrow keys.
escalationSettings.invalidHint: Every step needs at least one channel, and every deadline must be a whole number of 1 or more.
escalationSettings.empty: No escalation policy found for this flag colour.
escalationSettings.saveError: Couldn't save the escalation policy. Please try again.

hhaConnectPrompt.title: Connect HHAeXchange
hhaConnectPrompt.content: Your organization has not connected HHAeXchange yet. Connect it in Settings to sync patients, caregivers and visits.

hhaCredentials.heading: HHAeXchange
hhaCredentials.subheading: Connect your organization's HHAeXchange account to sync patients, caregivers and visits.
hhaCredentials.formHint: We check these with HHAeXchange before saving. The secret and key are stored encrypted and never shown again.
hhaCredentials.saveError: Couldn't connect HHAeXchange. Please try again.
hhaCredentials.disconnectError: Couldn't disconnect HHAeXchange. Please try again.
hhaCredentials.disconnectContent: Syncing stops until you connect again. The HHAeXchange pages are hidden for everyone but admins, who are asked to connect.
